observed: NeMo-Speech.cpp supports German in the Magpie tokenizer path but text normalization is an optional preprocessing layer.

The pinned NeMo-Speech.cpp build leaves NEMO_SPEECH_WITH_NORM disabled by default; when TN is unavailable or the requested language grammar is absent, text can pass through unchanged with a warning rather than causing a hard failure.
The pinned NeMo-Speech.cpp repository contains the Sparrowhawk/OpenFST runtime integration and build script but does not vendor German TN FAR assets in its models tree.
NeMo-Speech.cpp requires a tokenizer FAR and verbalizer FAR staged as tokenize_and_classify.far and verbalize.far before Sparrowhawk setup.

The official NVIDIA/NeMo-text-processing source contains German TN grammars covering cardinal, date, decimal, electronic, fraction, measure, money, ordinal, telephone, time, whitelist and word classes.
The German NeMo-text-processing ClassifyFst emits a cache FAR named _<input_case>_de_tn_<deterministic>_deterministic<whitelist>.far with archive entry tokenize_and_classify.
The German NeMo-text-processing VerbalizeFinalFst emits de_tn_<deterministic>_deterministic_verbalizer.far with archive entry verbalize.

Those official German cache filenames are not directly among the exact filenames NeMo-Speech.cpp requires; its generic tokenizer scan also requires the filename to contain tokenize, which the German ClassifyFst cache filename does not. Its verbalizer lookup is exact rather than generic.

Therefore the pinned local path is not grammar-artifact-self-contained: a reproducible generation plus explicit staging/rename step is required before German TN can be treated as closed for benchmarking.

inference.statement: The generated German FAR contents appear structurally bridgeable because their archive entry names match the classifier/verbalizer roles expected by Sparrowhawk, but binary/runtime compatibility and exact staging correctness are not yet proven.
inference.counterhypothesis: The NeMo-text-processing-generated FARs may fail in the pinned NeMo-Speech.cpp Sparrowhawk/OpenFST stack despite matching semantic archive entries, for example because of OpenFST/Pynini serialization/version or deployment-format differences.
inference.falsifier: Generate the two German FARs from the pinned NeMo-text-processing commit, stage copies under a de_tn_... directory as tokenize_and_classify.far and verbalize.far, build pinned NeMo-Speech.cpp with NEMO_SPEECH_WITH_NORM=ON against its pinned OpenFST/Sparrowhawk dependencies, and run the source-bound text-normalizer test corpus. Any load/setup/rewrite incompatibility falsifies direct bridgeability.

benchmark_consequence.risk: Without an explicit TN cell, German TTS tests containing 12, 30.08.2026, 19,99 EUR, 3,5 km, phone numbers or technical mixed text can silently measure tokenizer/model behavior on raw written forms rather than a production-quality German text pipeline.
